notes.title: Share Your Thoughts on the Arkhe Demo!
notes.content:
[h1]🌟 Your Feedback Matters – Share Your Thoughts on the Arkhe Demo! 🌟[/h1]

Hello Adventurers,

We hope you've enjoyed diving into the world of Arkhe with our demo! Your journey through the mystical landscapes, encounters with enigmatic characters, and first taste of the thrilling gameplay are just the beginning.

📝 We Need Your Feedback!
As we continue to refine and enhance Arkhe, your insights and experiences are incredibly valuable to us. We want to hear all about your time with the demo—what you loved, what challenged you, and any suggestions you might have.

💬 How to Share Your Feedback:
Leave a Comment: Drop your thoughts in the comments section below. Be as detailed as you like!

Steam Reviews: Write a review on our Steam page to let others know what you think. Your reviews help us and future players!

Social Media Pages: Join the discussion on our social media pages. Engage with other players and share your opinion.

🌟 Thank You for Your Support!
Your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the final release of Arkhe. We're committed to delivering an unforgettable adventure, and with your help, we can make it even better.

🚀 Share Your Feedback and Help Us Improve Arkhe! 🚀

Thank you for being a part of our community and for your invaluable input. We look forward to reading your feedback and continuing this journey together.

Happy Adventuring,
TopChan Games.

notes.title: Unveil the Secrets of Arkhe – Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]🌌 Unveil the Secrets of Arkhe – Wishlist Now! 🌌[/b][/h1]

Hello Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce Arkhe, an immersive adventure that will transport you to a mysterious and breathtaking world governed by the Numerals, powerful ancient creatures known as Arkhe, representing the essence of creation itself. Get ready to explore the unknown and embark on an epic journey with a stoic warrior Derg and an emotional sorceress Agatha. Here’s a sneak peek into some of the key features that make Arkhe a must-play experience:

🎮 Key Features:
🔹 Rich Storytelling: Dive into a deeply woven narrative filled with mysteries, compelling characters, and unexpected twists. Every decision you make influences the outcome of your journey.

🔹 Dual Perspective: It is narrated from the perspectives of two characters: Derg and Agatha. Derg's dialogue is highlighted in blue, while Agatha's is in pink, making it easy to follow each character's viewpoint.

🔹 Dive Deeper into the World: Explore and investigate by clicking on active points in certain areas, receiving descriptions through character dialogue.

🔹 Stunning Visuals: Each scene is designed to keep you engaged from the start of the adventure!

🛡️ Prepare for the Adventure of a Lifetime!
Arkhe is not just a game; it's a journey that will captivate your senses and challenge your mind. We can’t wait for you to experience the wonders and dangers of this enchanting world.

🚀 Wishlist Arkhe Now! 🚀

Adding Arkhe to your wishlist helps us bring this extraordinary adventure to more players and ensures you don’t miss out on any updates or announcements. Click the “Add to your wishlist” button now and be among the first to step into the world of Arkhe!

Join our community and stay tuned for more exciting news, trailers, and behind-the-scenes content. Your adventure awaits!

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2977310/Arkhe/]Add Arkhe to Your Wishlist[/url]

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in Arkhe!

Happy Adventuring,
TopChan Games Development Team
